## Change

Describe the server or map behaviour changed and why.

## Evidence

- [ ] The documented source checks pass (or manual `CI / Required` is green).
- [ ] Public state/events contain no forbidden fields or message text.
- [ ] Route changes remain high-confidence and fail closed.
- [ ] No live data, credentials, checkpoints, or packet captures are included.
- [ ] The change does not add country-specific data, Labs, an app, history, chat, databases, or unrelated features.
